steps: Acute pulmonary oedema: sit up, high-flow O2, IV loop diuretic (furosemide), IV nitrate if hypertensive.
Consider CPAP/NIV for severe respiratory distress.
Daily weights, fluid/salt restriction, monitor renal function and potassium.
Chronic HFrEF: ACEi/ARNI + beta-blocker + MRA + SGLT2 inhibitor.

confirm: Dyspnoea, orthopnoea, raised JVP, basal crackles, oedema; raised BNP/NT-proBNP; echo for ejection fraction.
disposition: Admit; ICU/HDU if cardiogenic shock or NIV.
